news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Negative equity (-₹9.9m). Earnings have declined by 34% per year over the past 5 years. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.05 (vs ₹0.34 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.05 (up from ₹0.34 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹11.6m (up 110% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹186.0k (up ₹1.54m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.6% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 52% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 55% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
